responsibility: This definition module declares the main DynamicStrings-based numeric conversion library for GNU Modula-2. It belongs to the runtime number-formatting and parsing subsystem and exports conversions between strings and INTEGER, CARDINAL, LONGINT, LONGCARD, SHORTCARD, REAL/LONGREAL forms, shorthand decimal/hex/octal/binary helpers, and post-processing routines such as ToSigFig and ToDecimalPlaces, making it the high-level managed-string companion to NumberIO and FpuIO.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the StringConvert pair: it only names the exported DynamicStrings-based conversion and rounding procedures and their signatures, whereas StringConvert.mod contains the parsing, formatting, ldtoa/strtold integration, and carry/rounding implementation.
